name: quat-3d
description: Build, tune, script, debug and playtest worlds in a running quat-3d engine: the quat-mcp MCP server plus workflow skills (build-level, tune-look, debug-physics-glitch, write-gameplay-script, design-npc-behaviour, author-material-shader, playtest, inspect-scene, debug-session).

quat_mcp_command.title: quat-mcp binary
quat_mcp_command.description: The quat-mcp server to run: "quat-mcp" when it is on your PATH (cargo install --path tools/quat-mcp), or the absolute path of tools/quat-mcp/target/release/quat-mcp.

engine_port.title: Engine port
engine_port.description: The port the engine's remote-control endpoint listens on (the engine's QUAT_REMOTE value).
